resources.string: This extension calculates your Aerodynamic Drag Coefficient (CdA) in real-time. It applies the laws of physics by taking the total power you apply to the pedals and subtracting rolling resistance and gravity (gradient).\n\nWhat is left is the power needed to overcome wind resistance. The lower the CdA, the faster you will go with the same watts.

For exact calculations on the road, you MUST adjust these values. The extension will automatically use this data on the Karoo:
• Rider Mass: Your body weight with clothes.
• Bike Mass: Bike weight + bottles + gear.

• Rolling Resistance (Crr): Depends on your tires and terrain:
 - 0.0025 to 0.0030: Track, TT or premium road on perfect tarmac.
 - 0.0035 to 0.0040: Normal road tires on average tarmac.
 - 0.0050 to 0.0060: Very rough tarmac, wet or slow tires.
 - 0.0060 to 0.0080+: Gravel, dirt roads or cobbles.
Use the controls below to simulate different wind, power, and gradient scenarios. On the road, the Karoo will read this data from your sensors.
